selection_rationale: Direct research ancestor and closest learned silent-patch detector.
motivating_problem: Security fixes can remain silent because commit text and code do not explicitly disclose security impact.
general_principle: Combine generated patch explanations, code-text alignment, label-wise instruction learning, and stochastic batch contrastive learning.
proof_or_performance_argument: Report comparative classification results and ablations on PatchDB and SPI-DB.
practical_connection: Prioritize silent patches at commit time from text and code.
evaluation_breadth: Two public security-patch corpora with multiple learned baselines and component analyses.
artifact_strength: Substantial learned pipeline and reproducible model/data description; no independently replayable semantic certificate.
narrative_sequence: Operational risk, missing signal, model design, evaluation, then threats and implications.
section_pattern: Introduction; background; approach; experimental design; results; analysis; threats; related work.
bibliography_role: Anchor for the problem and explicit boundary against learned classification claims.
figure_table_role: Architecture diagram, dataset/baseline tables, and ablation/result figures organize the evidence.
project_delta: This project studies a replayable bounded feature and evidence sufficiency, not a replacement universal classifier.

selection_rationale: Strong benchmark-design adversary for code-centric security-patch detection.
motivating_problem: Reported gains are difficult to compare when datasets, splits, and false-positive regimes differ.
general_principle: Unify datasets and evaluation while explicitly testing repository and temporal transfer.
proof_or_performance_argument: Evaluate many model/dataset combinations and expose sensitivity to split and operating point.
practical_connection: Choose detectors under realistic low-false-positive review conditions.
evaluation_breadth: Twenty datasets, more than 180,000 commits, and 270 evaluated model configurations in the published study.
artifact_strength: High-strength benchmark and protocol contribution; emphasizes reproducible evaluation rather than proof-carrying evidence.
narrative_sequence: Evaluation problem, unified benchmark, research questions, large comparative results, recommendations.
section_pattern: Introduction; benchmark construction; models; protocol; results; threats; recommendations.
bibliography_role: Primary support for demanding a sealed temporal frame and a strong same-budget comparator.
figure_table_role: Dataset taxonomy and broad result tables carry the central argument.
project_delta: The present microcohort deliberately fails those utility gates instead of treating convenience-sample P@20 as prospective evidence.

selection_rationale: Closest semantic patch-analysis method.
motivating_problem: Coarse security-patch labels do not identify which edits are security-relevant or whether individual changes are safe.
general_principle: Use differential symbolic execution to compare before/after behavior at fine granularity.
proof_or_performance_argument: Evaluate safe-patch identification over tens of thousands of commits with manual assessment.
practical_connection: Reduce supply-chain patch risk by locating semantically relevant changes.
evaluation_breadth: 45,296 commits plus detailed manual validation in the reported study.
artifact_strength: Executable analysis with substantial empirical scope; the analysis result is not packaged as the same small replay contract used here.
narrative_sequence: Supply-chain problem, differential formulation, implementation, large evaluation, error analysis.
section_pattern: Introduction; motivation; design; implementation; evaluation; discussion; related work.
bibliography_role: Closest-work adversary that prevents claiming differential symbolic execution itself as novel.
figure_table_role: Pipeline diagrams and precision/coverage tables connect method to deployment questions.
project_delta: The delta is the explicit checker contract, non-entailment results, and fail-closed empirical readiness decision.

selection_rationale: Closest repository-context security-patch detector.
motivating_problem: Patch-only representations omit repository context needed to distinguish security changes.
general_principle: Represent repository-level program structure and sequence context with progressive learning.
proof_or_performance_argument: Compare repository-aware detection against patch-level baselines on security-patch datasets.
practical_connection: Improve triage by exploiting context around changed code.
evaluation_breadth: Multi-dataset learned evaluation with ablations of repository graph and progressive components.
artifact_strength: Rich repository representation and learned baseline; requires training and does not emit replayable bounded evidence.
narrative_sequence: Context gap, repository representation, model, experiments, ablations and cases.
section_pattern: Introduction; motivation; approach; experimental setup; results; discussion; threats.
bibliography_role: Supports the strong-baseline gate and the claim that a lexical control is not state of the art.
figure_table_role: Repository graph overview and ablation/result tables are central.
project_delta: The artifact does not claim competitive utility against RepoSPD until a same-budget temporal comparison exists.

selection_rationale: Graph-semantic detector directly adjacent to the proposed mechanism.
motivating_problem: Token sequences lose structural and dependence information in security patches.
general_principle: Build enriched pre/post code-property graphs and learn patch representations with graph neural networks.
proof_or_performance_argument: Report gains over text and sequence baselines on established security-patch corpora.
practical_connection: Prioritize security patches from semantic graph structure.
evaluation_breadth: PatchDB/SPI-DB evaluation with comparisons and component analyses.
artifact_strength: Substantial released model/data pipeline; evidence remains a learned score rather than an independently replayed relation.
narrative_sequence: Representation weakness, PatchCPG construction, graph model, experiments and interpretation.
section_pattern: Introduction; background; approach; evaluation; discussion; threats; related work.
bibliography_role: Strong semantic-learning comparator and boundary against equating graph context with checked behavior.
figure_table_role: PatchCPG architecture figures and model-comparison tables communicate the contribution.
project_delta: The present work owns a small auditable certificate and refuses to claim graph-model-level detection effectiveness.

selection_rationale: Foundational data resource used by many security-patch detectors.
motivating_problem: Security-patch research lacked a large curated benchmark with patch and vulnerability context.
general_principle: Construct and validate a large-scale security-patch dataset with systematic collection and characterization.
proof_or_performance_argument: Use dataset statistics and downstream tasks to demonstrate research utility.
practical_connection: Enable comparable security-patch detection and analysis.
evaluation_breadth: Large multi-project patch collection with taxonomy, statistics, and quality checks.
artifact_strength: High-value public dataset; labels and sampling assumptions remain empirical rather than semantic proof.
narrative_sequence: Data gap, collection pipeline, dataset analysis, applications, limitations.
section_pattern: Introduction; methodology; dataset analysis; use cases; threats; related work.
bibliography_role: Grounds the public-label ecosystem and motivates explicit provenance/selection ledgers.
figure_table_role: Collection pipeline diagrams and descriptive tables establish coverage and composition.
project_delta: The microcohort is not represented as a population sample of PatchDB or as evidence of dataset-wide coverage.

selection_rationale: Early practical security-relevant commit classifier.
motivating_problem: Security-relevant commits are difficult to identify from ordinary maintenance traffic.
general_principle: Combine text and code-change features in a supervised classifier.
proof_or_performance_argument: Cross-validated classification with manually constructed negatives and precision/recall tradeoffs.
practical_connection: Support practical review queues for security teams.
evaluation_breadth: 2,715 Java commits in the reported experiment, with manual negative construction.
artifact_strength: Clear practical baseline but limited language/domain and no temporal blind evaluation.
narrative_sequence: Operational problem, feature/model design, evaluation, limitations.
section_pattern: Introduction; approach; experiment; results; related work; conclusion.
bibliography_role: Historical classifier baseline and evidence for scrutinizing negative sampling.
figure_table_role: Feature summary and precision/recall tables carry the empirical case.
project_delta: The closure audit treats label-dependent candidate selection as a failed gate rather than a benign detail.

selection_rationale: FSE-track predecessor using development text to identify security issues.
motivating_problem: Security-related changes may be hidden in ordinary commit and bug-report language.
general_principle: Learn from commit messages and bug reports to identify security issues.
proof_or_performance_argument: Evaluate classifiers and validate on a broad production corpus.
practical_connection: Surface likely security work before explicit disclosure.
evaluation_breadth: Reported evaluation plus validation across more than 2,000 projects; commit messages are often sparse.
artifact_strength: Broad practical validation but reliant on text availability and retrospective labels.
narrative_sequence: Missing-signal problem, text features, model, evaluation, production validation.
section_pattern: Introduction; approach; evaluation; production study; threats; related work.
bibliography_role: Same-track calibration for concise problem framing and practical validation.
figure_table_role: Workflow figure and classifier/validation tables bridge model and operational use.
project_delta: Replayable evidence addresses a different trust question and cannot inherit text-model generalization.

selection_rationale: Strong symbolic-analysis predecessor for patch impact.
motivating_problem: Patch floods make manual security-impact assessment infeasible.
general_principle: Compare symbolic rules under under-constrained execution to characterize changed security impact.
proof_or_performance_argument: Demonstrate high precision on a large patch corpus with known security bugs.
practical_connection: Filter patches by precise behavioral impact.
evaluation_breadth: About 66,000 commits and 227 security bugs in the reported evaluation.
artifact_strength: Strong semantic engine and practical scale; trusted modeling assumptions remain broader than the tiny checked IR here.
narrative_sequence: Patch-flood motivation, symbolic rules, system, evaluation, limitations.
section_pattern: Introduction; design; implementation; evaluation; discussion; related work.
bibliography_role: Prevents novelty claims over semantic patch differencing and motivates explicit trust boundaries.
figure_table_role: System architecture and rule-comparison examples are paired with large evaluation tables.
project_delta: This project narrows the accepted relation and makes admission, replay, and empirical readiness separately auditable.

selection_rationale: Direct learned patch-classification tool predecessor.
motivating_problem: Commit messages and code changes contain complementary signals for patch classification.
general_principle: Jointly encode message and diff structure with a deep neural model.
proof_or_performance_argument: Demonstrate an end-to-end tool and classification performance.
practical_connection: Automate patch triage from development artifacts.
evaluation_breadth: Tool paper with benchmark results and an operational workflow.
artifact_strength: Accessible implementation framing; limited evidence about temporal deployment and no checker contract.
narrative_sequence: Problem, model overview, tool workflow, evaluation, availability.
section_pattern: Introduction; approach; tool; evaluation; conclusion.
bibliography_role: Establishes the learned patch-classification lineage.
figure_table_role: Architecture and tool screenshots/summary tables emphasize end-to-end use.
project_delta: The witness feature is complementary and is not claimed superior without a sealed comparison.

selection_rationale: Influential code-change representation used in patch tasks.
motivating_problem: Flat change encodings discard hierarchical relationships among files, hunks, and lines.
general_principle: Learn distributed hierarchical representations of code changes from removed/added code.
proof_or_performance_argument: Evaluate representations on multiple downstream change-analysis tasks.
practical_connection: Provide reusable change embeddings for software analytics.
evaluation_breadth: Multi-task empirical evaluation with comparisons to prior change representations.
artifact_strength: Reusable learned representation and public implementation; not an inspectable safety argument.
narrative_sequence: Representation gap, hierarchy-aware model, downstream tasks, experiments, analysis.
section_pattern: Introduction; related work; model; tasks; experiments; discussion.
bibliography_role: Calibrates representation-learning baselines and narrative economy.
figure_table_role: Hierarchical architecture figures and task tables explain transfer across applications.
project_delta: The project deliberately forbids embeddings in its owned mechanism and therefore needs a same-budget external baseline before utility claims.

selection_rationale: Closest public TensorFlow VFC detector and provenance source.
motivating_problem: Vulnerability-fixing commits are expensive to curate manually at ecosystem scale.
general_principle: Combine commit information and code changes to detect and curate VFCs.
proof_or_performance_argument: Evaluate detection and release a public dataset/tool workflow.
practical_connection: Support scalable vulnerability-data curation.
evaluation_breadth: Cross-project public data and a TensorFlow subset used as provenance for this audit.
artifact_strength: Useful reproducible detector/dataset source; its labels do not make a selected microcohort prospective.
narrative_sequence: Curation problem, detector, dataset construction, evaluation, release.
section_pattern: Introduction; approach; dataset; evaluation; threats; related work.
bibliography_role: Primary provenance bridge for the retained public microcohort.
figure_table_role: Pipeline and dataset/result tables connect curation method to released records.
project_delta: The project preserves immutable source identities and still marks label-dependent selection as a failed gate.

selection_rationale: Demonstrably influential just-in-time quality-assurance study.
motivating_problem: Post-release defect prediction is too late for immediate review allocation.
general_principle: Predict risky changes at commit time and evaluate both classification and effort-aware utility.
proof_or_performance_argument: Cross-system empirical modeling with practical effort-aware measures.
practical_connection: Allocate scarce review effort before integration.
evaluation_breadth: Six open-source and five commercial projects in the reported study.
artifact_strength: Large multi-system design and mature threats analysis; labels target defects, not security.
narrative_sequence: Operational motivation, model factors, multi-project evaluation, effort-aware analysis, implications.
section_pattern: Introduction; background; study design; results; discussion; threats.
bibliography_role: Calibrates the review-budget framing and demand for operational metrics.
figure_table_role: Factor tables and effort-aware curves connect statistical accuracy to reviewer effort.
project_delta: P@20 is fixed as a review-budget metric, while the paper avoids transferring defect-prediction validity to security patches.

selection_rationale: Influential treatment of spatial and temporal experimental bias.
motivating_problem: Random splits can overstate security-classifier performance under ecosystem and time drift.
general_principle: Constrain evaluation across space and time and distinguish realistic from biased protocols.
proof_or_performance_argument: Re-evaluate malware classifiers under temporally and spatially faithful splits.
practical_connection: Estimate deployment-relevant security-classifier behavior.
evaluation_breadth: 129,000 Android applications and multiple classifiers in the reported experiments.
artifact_strength: Strong protocol and released framework; application domain differs from patches.
narrative_sequence: Bias diagnosis, framework, re-evaluation, recommendations, limitations.
section_pattern: Introduction; threat model; methodology; experiments; guidelines; related work.
bibliography_role: Core support for temporal holdout and candidate-frame gates.
figure_table_role: Timeline/schema diagrams and cross-protocol result tables expose evaluation inflation.
project_delta: The microcohort refuses a prospective interpretation precisely because it lacks this temporal discipline.

selection_rationale: Influential symbolic-execution system and evaluation model.
motivating_problem: Manual tests miss deep behaviors in complex systems software.
general_principle: Use path-oriented symbolic execution and constraint solving to generate high-coverage tests.
proof_or_performance_argument: Apply the system to Coreutils and BusyBox and report coverage and real bugs.
practical_connection: Find correctness defects automatically in production code.
evaluation_breadth: 89 Coreutils utilities, 75 BusyBox utilities, 452 applications, and 56 reported bugs.
artifact_strength: Strong open system and broad evaluation; solver/OS models form a substantial trusted base.
narrative_sequence: Testing gap, engine, environment models, system evaluation, bug findings.
section_pattern: Introduction; design; implementation; evaluation; limitations; related work.
bibliography_role: Calibrates bounded-execution claims and the need to state environment/model limits.
figure_table_role: Architecture, coverage plots, and bug tables balance mechanism and practical impact.
project_delta: The finite producer is intentionally much smaller and cannot imply KLEE-scale source coverage.

selection_rationale: Foundational producer/checker trust-separation paper.
motivating_problem: A consumer should not have to trust a code producer to enforce safety.
general_principle: Require a producer-supplied proof that a small checker validates against a safety policy.
proof_or_performance_argument: Argue soundness and practicality of proof-carrying code through a concrete architecture.
practical_connection: Move trust from complex production to compact validation.
evaluation_breadth: Foundational formal architecture with illustrative implementation evidence.
artifact_strength: Conceptually strong trust boundary; its theorem setting is much richer than this finite JSON certificate.
narrative_sequence: Trust problem, architecture, formal condition, implementation considerations, discussion.
section_pattern: Introduction; framework; safety policy/proofs; implementation; related work.
bibliography_role: Calibrates the producer/checker argument and prevents novelty inflation.
figure_table_role: Architecture diagrams make the trusted/untrusted partition explicit.
project_delta: The paper claims only relative replay soundness for a supplied finite representation, not proof-carrying source code.

selection_rationale: Influential bounded translation-validation exemplar.
motivating_problem: Compiler optimizations can introduce subtle miscompilations despite extensive testing.
general_principle: Use bounded SMT-based translation validation for LLVM transformations.
proof_or_performance_argument: Run continuously at scale and report real optimizer and specification defects without false alarms in the studied corpus.
practical_connection: Check transformations independently of the optimizer that produced them.
evaluation_breadth: Large LLVM deployment reporting 47 bugs, 28 fixes, and 8 language-reference patches.
artifact_strength: High-strength open checker and real deployment evidence; boundedness and LLVM semantics are explicit.
narrative_sequence: Correctness problem, formal model, validator, engineering, deployment findings.
section_pattern: Introduction; semantics; validation algorithm; implementation; evaluation; limitations.
bibliography_role: Calibrates bounded-checker scope and real-world validation standards.
figure_table_role: Semantic pipeline figures and bug-category tables connect theorem obligations to deployment.
project_delta: The project adopts bounded replay but does not claim compiler-grade source semantics or deployment scale.

selection_rationale: Adjacent semantic-change analysis foundational to the mechanism.
motivating_problem: Regression analysis needs executions focused on behavioral differences between program versions.
general_principle: Differential symbolic execution summarizes and explores changed behavior rather than each version independently.
proof_or_performance_argument: Demonstrate precise change characterization on evolving Java systems.
practical_connection: Guide regression testing and debugging toward affected behavior.
evaluation_breadth: Two Java program histories in the reported evaluation.
artifact_strength: Clear semantic formulation; limited breadth and not a security-patch ranking study.
narrative_sequence: Change-analysis problem, differential execution, examples, evaluation, implications.
section_pattern: Introduction; approach; implementation; evaluation; related work.
bibliography_role: Technical ancestor for differential execution, not evidence of security relevance.
figure_table_role: Execution-difference examples and case-study tables explain the relation.
project_delta: The project adds explicit certificate replay and ranking non-entailment rather than renaming differential execution.

selection_rationale: Adjacent semantic-difference tool with a language-agnostic IR.
motivating_problem: Version comparison across implementation languages needs a common semantic representation.
general_principle: Translate imperative programs to a common form and verify relational differences.
proof_or_performance_argument: Demonstrate semantic differencing across examples and tool integrations.
practical_connection: Support regression verification independent of source syntax.
evaluation_breadth: Tool-oriented evaluation over representative imperative programs.
artifact_strength: Useful language-agnostic abstraction; correctness depends on frontends and solver semantics.
narrative_sequence: Portability problem, IR/relational method, tool, examples and evaluation.
section_pattern: Introduction; design; implementation; evaluation; related work.
bibliography_role: Supports the source-to-IR boundary and frontend gate.
figure_table_role: Translation/analysis architecture figures are the key explanatory device.
project_delta: The automatic frontend here recognizes only a declared guard grammar and explicitly abstains elsewhere.

selection_rationale: Closest witness-validation architecture in FSE.
motivating_problem: Verifier results are difficult to exchange and independently recheck across tools.
general_principle: Standardize witnesses and validate them with independent verifiers in a stepwise workflow.
proof_or_performance_argument: Demonstrate cross-tool witness exchange and re-verification.
practical_connection: Increase trust and interoperability of verification results.
evaluation_breadth: Multiple verifiers and witness-validation scenarios in the reported study.
artifact_strength: Strong open witness ecosystem and formal workflow; targets safety verification, not patch triage.
narrative_sequence: Trust/interoperability problem, witness format, validation workflow, experiments.
section_pattern: Introduction; concepts; exchange format; validation; evaluation; related work.
bibliography_role: Direct calibration for checker independence and claim-bound evidence.
figure_table_role: Workflow diagrams and compatibility/result matrices communicate interoperability.
project_delta: The contribution is a patch-specific bounded relation plus empirical closure, not witness validation in general.

selection_rationale: Adjacent result on the gap between passing checks and correctness.
motivating_problem: Test-suite-adequate patches can be plausible yet semantically incorrect.
general_principle: Analyze generated patches beyond test acceptance and characterize overfitting.
proof_or_performance_argument: Manually and empirically re-evaluate patches from generate-and-validate systems.
practical_connection: Prevent automated repair success rates from being mistaken for correctness.
evaluation_breadth: Multiple repair systems and benchmark defects in the reported analysis.
artifact_strength: Influential negative evaluation; manual correctness assessment has its own subjectivity.
narrative_sequence: Success claim, re-evaluation method, error taxonomy, implications.
section_pattern: Introduction; systems/data; analysis; results; threats; related work.
bibliography_role: Supports the central distinction between accepted evidence and global patch correctness.
figure_table_role: Correctness-rate tables and patch examples expose the plausibility gap.
project_delta: A replayed local witness is explicitly not treated as proof of a globally correct or secure patch.

selection_rationale: Adjacent security-repair work using explicit safety properties.
motivating_problem: Generic repair objectives do not encode vulnerability-specific safety requirements.
general_principle: Drive patch generation with explicit safety properties and program analysis.
proof_or_performance_argument: Evaluate repairs on real vulnerabilities and compare repair success/correctness.
practical_connection: Generate vulnerability patches aligned with stated security properties.
evaluation_breadth: Reported repair of 32 out of 42 real vulnerabilities.
artifact_strength: Strong property-guided mechanism; the property and repair search differ from post-hoc triage.
narrative_sequence: Specification gap, property language, repair algorithm, evaluation, limitations.
section_pattern: Introduction; safety properties; synthesis; implementation; evaluation; related work.
bibliography_role: Calibrates the value and limits of explicit safety predicates.
figure_table_role: Repair workflow diagrams and vulnerability-result tables connect properties to outcomes.
project_delta: The fixed predicate library is a bounded triage feature and does not claim vulnerability repair.
